comment.comment:
PONS bull case: actual fees when including post-bond lp sweeps is significantly higher than most are referencing. Revenue & dex volume is also quickly approaching Pump’s (valued > 10x higher), while Robinhood is showing early signs of being able to eclipse Solana this cycle. And Pump itself is undervalued by industry standards to begin with. Pair this with expected macro liquidity inflows into 2027 and topblasting rn doesn’t look so scary.

Bear case: other than black swans, this would be Pump adding RH support. Would almost certainly cause a large shortterm selloff. However, Pump playing catchup on a chain with a different culture and backing than Solana’s would not be as simple as deploying capital. Pump’s team historically is reactionary and plays it safe when it comes to making big changes (such as moving away from Raydium, or pivoting from streams -> socialfi, or doing their intended airdrop), so I think this is part of why theyre also historically undervalued. Pons is shipping way faster.

Pons is primed for a RH listing (esp after Hyperliquid) & potential backing from Vlad himself. It is unlikely that Pump would secure anything with Robinhood first given their conflicts of interest with Solana. On top of that, aesthetically and culturally, they just have more aura right now too.

TLDR: buy my bags. Pons has firstmover advantage and we are in the early innings of a crypto bull.
